details: For every finite binary concept class, $\mathrm{Edim}(\mathcal H)\geq\log_2|\mathcal H|$.
proof: Repeatedly choose a coordinate on which the current version space disagrees, retain a largest label fibre, and continue until the version space is a singleton. In the binary case each step retains at least half the current class, so this constructs an eluder sequence of length at least $\log_2|\mathcal H|$.
name: Combinatorial Eluder Dimension / Log Size
